mapper.insert: INSERT INTO algo_call_log (algorithm_type, user_id, user_type, user_level, department, call_time) VALUES (#{algorithmType}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{userLevel}, #{department}, #{callTime})
mapper.select:
SELECT
user_type user_level department
AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM algo_call_log WHERE call_time >= #{startDate} AND call_time <= #{endDate}
AND algorithm_type = #{algorithmType}
GROUP BY
user_type user_level department
ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT algorithm_type AS algorithmType,
user_type user_level department
AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM algo_call_log WHERE call_time >= #{startDate} AND call_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY algorithm_type,
user_type user_level department
ORDER BY algorithm_type, value DESC
